notes: Chunk 50: six pages, nine snapshot files read (all Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file's footer). Columbia 'Why a Columbia PhD? / Placement' is a five-area table (Accounting; Decision, Risk, and Operations; Finance and Economics; Management; Marketing) with columns Name | Graduation Year | Initial Placement; rows parsed verbatim, destination = Initial Placement cell as written, which sometimes embeds a role ('Post Doctoral Position, Stanford University', 'Visiting faculty, Cornell University...'); position left null rather than split. Integrator checks: (1) Yonatan Gur (DRO) is listed with Graduation Year 2014 in the 2015-08-30 snapshot and 2015 in the 2016-10-01 snapshot. (2) The 2016 Columbia snapshot drops Alicja Reuben (Management, 2013) and the 2007 Finance rows for Chang Yong Ha, Paul Hsu, Stanley Peterbursky and Ru Zhao, and adds 2015/2016 graduates. (3) Columbia Management job-market page lists '2014-15 Job Market Candidates' Ivana Katic, Jose Uribe, Abbie Wazlawek: recorded listedYear 2015 / job-market; the 2016 placement snapshot later lists Katic and Uribe as 2015 graduates and Wazlawek as 2016. Emory 'Job Placements': years are headings; page says the chart shows where graduates 'placed upon graduation', so yearMeaning recorded as 'placement' (the integrator may treat it as the graduation year). Between the 2015-09-04 and 2016-09-29 snapshots several destinations changed to what look like later affiliations rather than initial placements: Astrid Fontaine (CEIBS -> Porsche North America), Adina Sterling (Washington University -> Stanford University), Russell Jame (University of New South Wales, Australia -> University of Kentucky), Byoung-Hyoun Hwang (Purdue -> Cornell), Seoyoung Kim (Purdue -> Santa Clara), David Tan (Georgetown -> University of Washington); the older snapshot is the better initial-placement evidence. Thomas Bowe Hansen and Rachna Prakash have '(1st placement)' and '(2nd placement)' entries; destination holds the 1st, note holds the 2nd. Emory O&M 'Dissertations and Placements' lists six Organization & Management graduates with year, placement and dissertation title; year meaning unstated; the 2016 snapshot shows the same later-affiliation changes (Sterling -> Stanford, Navis -> Clemson, Tan -> University of Washington). Kelley 'PhD Placements' is a sampling of 18 academic placements across areas (format 'Name, Institution (Area, Year)'); year meaning unstated; only two are operations (Elliot Bendoly, Operations Management, 2001; Vikram Tiwari, Operations Management/Information Systems, 2008). ISB FPM 'Placements and Careers' names nobody and is listed under unreadable. Degree 'PhD' is recorded where the page itself is framed as the PhD/doctoral program's placement list (Columbia 'Recent Columbia PhD placements', Emory 'PhD Program', Kelley 'PhD Placements'), not from any per-person statement; the Columbia job-market rows carry degree null.
